title: Overnight Brief
lede: A deterministic environment built and measured against a computable optimum, a blindfold found in the observation vector, and two significance thresholds where there was one. Numbers below come straight from the result files.

sections.title: The finding that reframes the earlier runs

blocks.body: The observation vector carried only directed-edge frequencies. An agent could not see which pairs it believed confounded — the claim the thesis is about, always required for identification, and the largest remaining error category. The greedy baseline reads all three belief channels. So every learned-versus-greedy number produced so far compared a blindfolded learner against a sighted rule.

It surfaced in the deterministic environment, where observation fixes the skeleton and confounding is the only thing interventions resolve — so the handicap is total there, and merely severe elsewhere. --observe_belief_channels supplies the missing channels.

sections.title: Deterministic environment: coordination, measured against an optimum

blocks.body: Four agents, three shared variables, one intervention each — the configuration where measured coordination headroom peaks. Reported per window, because the all-agents conjunction falls exponentially in agent count whatever the policy does.

sections.title: What an episode actually looks like

blocks.body: One row per agent, one column per round. Node ringed in blue is the one that agent intervened on; edge colour is what the agent believes about that pair. The counter under each window is required claims resolved.

blocks.title: Greedy baseline, same seed
blocks.blurb: Each agent picks what is locally best for its own window, with no way to know another agent is about to cover the same variable.

blocks.body: The single significance threshold gates both skeleton search and interventional orientation, and their error costs are opposite. Splitting them, with orientation held at 0.01:

At 0.05 missed edges halve with no increase in invented ones and no rise in type errors — exactly what the single-knob sweep destroyed. Identification is flat because recovered edges land in unsure rather than right, but confidently-wrong windows fall 9.4 points. Recommended, not yet the default.

sections.title: Caveats, and what I would not claim yet

items: Single seed on the deterministic arms. The differences between reward variants are within seed noise until replicated — the ceiling comparison is the solid part.
The deterministic environment answers the infinite-data question only. It cannot speak to sample efficiency or robustness; that is what the statistical layer is for.
The belief-channels fix changes obs_size, so it voids old checkpoints and every pre-fix number is a blindfolded-learner number.
Version-space enumeration is bounded by window DENSITY, not variable count: k ≤ 6 is the usable range, and a dense k=7 window rejected 94% of worlds.
